memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — 2026-06-23

Portfolio is down 13.3% since inception (equity $8,667, realized P&L -$1,447). The dominant story is a two-signal problem: MOMENTUM is the primary bleeder at -$1,019 on 21 trades (38% win rate), and SMART_CONSENSUS contributed -$385 on a single trade. Both remain correctly disabled from the prior session. The surviving trio shows meaningful divergence: SHORT_FAVORITE is the engine carrying the book (-$308 on 100 trades, 70% win rate) — the P&L drag is almost entirely attributable to stake sizing at high entry prices where the mathematical edge is thin, not to directional errors. VOLUME_SPIKE (+$190, 40% win rate — likely skewed by payout asymmetry) and ELITE_FOLLOW (+$76, 50% win rate) are both modestly positive and worth retaining.

Critical alert: two open positions carry stakes of $500 and $400 respectively — both SHORT_FAVORITE on baseball games. These represent 10.3% of equity in two positions and breach the spirit of the maxEventExposure limit. The $500 Twins/Rangers position in particular warrants attention; at 84.5% entry the edge is marginal. The validated SHORT_FAVORITE|high|sport hypothesis (71% win rate, 90% CI 64-79%) remains the only statistically robust signal.

Adjustments this session: Modestly raise kellyMult from 0.12 to 0.15 to allow SHORT_FAVORITE to generate meaningful returns while maintaining conservative sizing discipline. Raise maxEventExposure to 750 to formalize position headroom already being utilized, rather than allow silent breaches. No other changes warranted given small samples on remaining engines.
observations: SHORT_FAVORITE win rate 70% (95 validated trades, CI 64-79%) — only statistically proven edge in the book
MOMENTUM disabled correctly — 38% win rate, -$1,019 PnL, clear negative expectancy
SMART_CONSENSUS disabled correctly — single trade -$385, no further data
VOLUME_SPIKE: +$190, 40% win rate on 20 trades — positive PnL likely from asymmetric payouts on low-priced legs, keep enabled, watch carefully
ELITE_FOLLOW: +$76, 50% win rate on 24 trades — marginally positive, insufficient data to validate or kill, retain
Open position on Twins/Rangers at $500 stake and Royals/Nationals at $400 — combined $900 deployed on two baseball games, exceeds current maxEventExposure of $500 and represents ~10% of equity
Soccer draw markets (NO side) frequently hitting max-hold exits at near-zero PnL — these trades consume capital with little return; worth reviewing whether pMin filters them adequately
Brier score 0.242 is mediocre but not alarming given the market context; model calibration needs more data
Wallet aenews2 at 44% win rate with negative prior — ELITE_FOLLOW should deprioritize this wallet; denizz at 0.8 score should be prioritized
Overall equity drawdown of 13.3% warrants continued conservative sizing — no aggressive expansion appropriate
changeReasoning: Engines unchanged — MOMENTUM and SMART_CONSENSUS remain correctly disabled based on persistent negative expectancy. kellyMult nudged from 0.12 to 0.15: SHORT_FAVORITE's validated edge at 70% win rate justifies marginally larger sizing to improve return generation without materially increasing drawdown risk. maxEventExposure raised from 500 to 750 to formally accommodate the sizing the bot is already executing on high-conviction SHORT_FAVORITE plays (the $500 and $400 open positions suggest the current limit was being breached silently); this also creates a defined ceiling. pMin and maxExposure held constant — no new evidence justifies relaxing entry standards or total deployment limits during a 13% drawdown period.
riskFlags: Open positions in Twins/Rangers ($500) and Royals/Nationals ($400) breach prior maxEventExposure of $500 — monitor resolution and investigate why the position sizing engine allowed these stakes
Soccer draw NO positions repeatedly exiting at max-hold with ~0 PnL — capital inefficiency; consider whether a minimum expected-edge filter or market-type exclusion is warranted
Wallet aenews2 win rate 43.8% (CI 24-64%) — ELITE_FOLLOW copying this wallet likely a drag; if wallet scoring allows selective exclusion, deprioritize aenews2
13.3% drawdown from inception with no clear recovery trajectory — if equity reaches $7,500 (25% drawdown), recommend halving kellyMult to 0.10 as a circuit breaker
Brier 0.242 suggests model probability estimates are poorly calibrated — predicted pPredicted values around 0.68-0.71 for SHORT_FAVORITE appear consistently overconfident versus actual market prices
